notes: DiscoFlate v3.35.0 (consolidation, part 3) — outcomes are now full action blocks. Minigame outcome tiers gain an Actions block (award_prize, capacity, competition, embed, …) on top of message+fires. chance/cointoss commands replace their device-only win/miss fires with 🟢 On WIN / 🔴 On MISS action blocks (old fires auto-migrate). This is the groundwork for bonus commands earnable from any game (e.g. perfect blackjack).
